rawFindings.title: Decoder drops valid v1 object fields named this$<digits>
rawFindings.explanation: This newly added filter discards any decoded object property whose name matches `this$\d+`. Hessian field names are data from the stream, and `this$0` can be a legitimate field name; the decoder now loses that value instead of returning the serialized object contents.
rawFindings.suggestion: Always assign the decoded field value here; handle circular references or JSON serialization concerns outside the decoder, or behind an explicit opt-in option.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Decoding the v1 buffer `4d7400074578616d706c65530006746869732430530001787a` now returns `{}` instead of `{ "this$0": "x" }`.

rawFindings.title: Decoder drops valid v2 object fields named this$<digits>
rawFindings.explanation: This newly added filter discards any decoded compact-object field whose name matches `this$\d+`. That silently removes serialized data for any class that legitimately has such a field name, so the decoded object no longer reflects the Hessian payload.
rawFindings.suggestion: Always assign the decoded field value here; handle circular references or JSON serialization concerns outside the decoder, or behind an explicit opt-in option.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: Decoding the v2 buffer `43074578616d706c659106746869732430600178` now returns `{}` instead of `{ "this$0": "x" }`.
